    function auctionSuggestedCalls(limit = 4) {
      if (
        !auctionCallMode()
        || !(auctionHasPresidentRole() || auctionHasViceRole())
      ) {
        return [];
      }

      return (state.auction?.callCandidates || [])
        .map(auctionSuggestedCallScore)
        .filter(Boolean)
        .sort((a, b) =>
          b.score - a.score
          || Number(b.player?.pfc || 0) - Number(a.player?.pfc || 0)
          || Number(b.player?.pma || 0) - Number(a.player?.pma || 0)
          || String(a.player?.name || '').localeCompare(String(b.player?.name || ''), 'it')
        )
        .slice(0, Math.max(1, Number(limit || 4)));
    }


    function renderAuctionSuggestedCalls() {

    function auctionSuggestedCallScore(player) {
      const d = state.auction || {};
      const info = auctionMyTeamDashboardData();

      if (!player || !info) {
        return null;
      }

      if (!auctionPlayerMatchesCurrentRolePhase(player)) {
        return null;
      }

      const capacity = auctionQueueCapacityForPlayer(player);
      if (!capacity.allowed) {
        return null;
      }

      if (
        auctionQueueRows()
          .some(item => item.player_id === player.id)
      ) {
        return null;
      }

      const mode = d.settings?.fantasy_mode || 'classic';
      const assignments = info.assignments || [];
      const queue = auctionQueueRows();
      let needScore = 0;
      let needLabel = '';

      if (mode === 'classic') {
        const role = player.classic_role || '—';
        const min = Number(info.roleLimits?.[role]?.min || 0);
        const acquired = assignments.filter(item => item.player?.classic_role === role).length;
        const queued = queue.filter(item => item.player?.classic_role === role).length;
        const missing = Math.max(0, min - acquired);
        const uncovered = Math.max(0, min - acquired - queued);

        needScore =
          uncovered > 0
            ? 70 + Math.min(20, uncovered * 8)
            : missing > 0
              ? 42
              : 8;

        needLabel =
          uncovered > 0
            ? `Mancano ${uncovered} ${role} al minimo`
            : missing > 0
              ? `${role} già coperto in Coda, ma non ancora acquistato`
              : `Slot ${role} ancora disponibile`;
      } else {
        const goalkeeper = playerRoles(player, mode)
          .some(role => ['P', 'Por'].includes(role));
        const bucket = goalkeeper ? 'Por' : 'MOV';
        const label = goalkeeper ? 'portieri' : 'movimento';
        const 

--- MATCH 2 @ 578954 ---

          ? 38
          : 0;

      const score =
        needScore
        + valueScore
        + budgetScore
        - backupPenalty;

      let secondary = '';
      if (pfc > 0 || pma > 0) {
        secondary = `PFC ${pfc || '—'} · PMA ${pma || '—'}`;
      } else if (slot > 0) {
        secondary = `Slot ${slot}`;
      } else if (quotation > 0) {
        secondary = `Qt. ${quotation}`;
      }

      return {
        player,
        score,
        reason:
          capacity.backup
            ? `${needLabel} · Backup oltre capienza attuale`
            : needLabel,
        secondary,
        quotation,
        slot
      };
    }

    const scoreBoost = baseScore >= 90 ? .12 : baseScore >= 70 ? .08 : baseScore >= 45 ? .04 : 0;
    let suggested = Math.max(1, Math.round(corrected * (1 + scoreBoost)));
    let ceiling = Math.max(suggested, Math.round(corrected * (1.12 + scoreBoost)));

    if (pref?.expected_spend != null) suggested = Math.max(1, Math.round((suggested * 2 + Number(pref.expected_spend)) / 3));
    if (pref?.max_price != null) ceiling = Math.min(ceiling, Math.max(1, Number(pref.max_price)));

    const budget = Number(info?.maxBid);
    if (Number.isFinite(budget)) {
      ceiling = Math.min(ceiling, Math.max(0, budget));
      suggested = Math.min(suggested, ceiling);
    }

    return { suggested, ceiling, pfc, pma, liveFactor };
  }

  const originalSuggestedScore = auctionSuggestedCallScore;
  auctionSuggestedCallScore = function(player) {
    const item = originalSuggestedScore(player);
    if (!item) return null;
    const pref = v7Preference(player);
    const stat = v7Stat(player);
    const features = stat?.features || {};
    const preferenceBoost = pref?.strategy === 'top' ? 28 : pref?.is_favorite ? 14 : pref?.strategy === 'avoid' ? -90 : 0;
    const priorityBoost = Math.max(0, Number(pref?.priority || 0)) * 4;
    const trendBoost = Math.round(Number(features.trend_age_adjusted || 0) * 18);
    const confidenceBoost = Math.round(Number(features.trend_confidence || 0) * 4);
    const mantraBoost = v7MantraFit(player);
    item.score += preferenceBoost + priorityBoost + trendBoost + confidenceBoost + mantraBoost;
    item.preference = pref;
    item.features = features;
    item.mantraFit = mantraBoost;
    item.prices = v7StrategicPrices(player, item.score);
    return item;
  };

  const originalSuggestedCalls = auctionSuggestedCalls;
  auctionSuggestedCalls = function(limit = 4) {
    const dismissed = new Set(v7Dismissed().map(String));
    const all = (state.auction?.callCandidates || [])
      .map(auctionSuggestedCallScore)
      .filter(Boolean)
      .filter(item => !dismissed.has(String(item.player?.id || '')))
      .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score || String(a.player?.name || '').localeCompare(String(b.player?.name || ''), 'it'));
    return all.slice(0, Math.max(1, Number(limit || 4)));
  };

  function v7SuggestionModal(playerId) {

    const item = player ? auctionSuggestedCallScore(player) : null;
    if (!item) return;
    const roles = playerRoles(player, state.auction?.settings?.fantasy_mode);
    const score = clamp(Math.round(N

    function auctionViceInterestsFor(playerId) {
      return (
        state.auction?.viceInterests
          ?.[String(playerId)]
        || []
      );
    }


    function auctionOwnViceInterest(playerId) {
      return auctionViceInterestsFor(playerId)
        .find(item => item?.mine === true)
        || null;
    }


    function auctionPlayerIsQueued(playerId) {
      return auctionQueueRows()
        .some(item => item.player_id === playerId);
    }


    function auctionViceInterestTitle(item) {
      if (!item) {
        return '';
      }

      if (item.type === 'price') {
        return `${item.viceUsername || 'Vice'} · prezzo desiderato ${Number(item.amount || 0)}`;
      }

      const meta = AUCTION_VICE_INTERESTS[item.type];
      return `${item.viceUsername || 'Vice'} · ${meta?.label || item.type || 'segnale'}`;
    }


    function renderAuctionViceInterestReadout(
      playerId,
      { compact = false } = {}
    ) {
      if (!auctionHasPresidentRole()) {
        return '';
      }

      const interests =
        auctionViceInterestsFor(playerId);

      if (!interests.length) {
        return '';
      }

      return `
        <span class="auction-vice-interest-readout ${compact ? 'is-compact' : ''}">
          ${interests.map(item => {
            if (item.type === 'price') {
              return `
                <span
                  class="auction-vice-interest-badge is-price"
                  title="${esc(auctionViceInterestTitle(item))}"
                >V ${Number(item.amount || 0)}</span>
              `;
            }

            const meta =
              AUCTION_VICE_INTERESTS[item.type]
              || { emoji: '•', label: item.type || 'Segnale' };

            return `
              <span
                class="auction-vice-interest-badge"
                title="${esc(auctionViceInterestTitle(item))}"
              >${meta.emoji}</span>
            `;
          }).join('')}
        </span>
      `;
    }

    function auctionQueuePauseContext(data = state.auction) {
      const sessionId =
        data?.auctionSession?.id
        ||
        null;

      const teamId =
        data?.myTeam?.teamId
        ||
        data?.myTeam?.team?.id
        ||
        (
          data === state.auction
            ? auctionMyTeamId()
            : null
        );

      if (!sessionId || !teamId) {
        return null;
      }

      return {
        sessionId,
        teamId,
        key:
          `fantacalcio:auction-queue-paused:${sessionId}:${teamId}`
      };
    }


    function auctionQueuePausePending(data = state.auction) {
      const context =
        auctionQueuePauseContext(data);

      if (!context) {
        return null;
      }

      try {
        const raw =
          localStorage.getItem(
            context.key
          );

        if (!raw) {
          return null;
        }

        const parsed =
          JSON.parse(raw);

        if (
          typeof parsed?.paused
          !== 'boolean'
        ) {
          localStorage.removeItem(
            context.key
          );
          return null;
        }

        return {
          ...context,
          paused:
            parsed.paused === true,

    async function loadAuctionPersonalRoster(force = false) {
      if (!state.auction?.auctionSession) {
        state.auctionPersonalRoster = null;
        state.auctionPersonalRosterFetchedAt = 0;
        return;
      }

      const now = Date.now();

      if (
        !force &&
        state.auctionPersonalRoster &&
        now - state.auctionPersonalRosterFetchedAt < 5000
      ) {
        return;
      }

      try {
        const data = await api(
          ENDPOINTS.rosters,
          { action: 'getRosters' },
          { quiet: true }
        );

        if (data?.ok) {
          state.auctionPersonalRoster = data;
          state.auctionPersonalRosterFetchedAt = Date.now();
        }

      } catch (error) {
        console.error(
          'AUCTION ROSTERS:',
          error
        );
      }
    }

          ||

    function auctionQueueProjection(rows = auctionQueueRows()) {
      const info =
        auctionMyTeamDashboardData();

      const normalizedRows =
        Array.isArray(rows)
          ? rows
          : [];

      if (!info) {
        return normalizedRows.map(item => ({
          item,
          backup: false,
          reason: ''
        }));
      }

      const mode =
        state.auction?.settings?.fantasy_mode
        || 'classic';

      const assignments =
        info.assignments || [];

      const totalMaximum =
        Math.max(
          0,
          Number(
            info.rosterMax
            || info.rosterLimit
            || 0
          )
        );

      let projectedTotal =
        assignments.length;

      if (mode === 'classic') {
        const roleUsed = {};

        ['P', 'D', 'C', 'A'].forEach(role => {
          roleUsed[role] =
            assignments.filter(item =>
              item.player?.classic_role === role
            ).length;
        });

        return normalizedRows.map(item => {
          const role =
            item.player?.classic_role
            || '—';

          const roleMaximum =
            Math.max(
              0,
              Number(
                info.roleLimits?.[role]?.max
                || 0
              )
            );

          const totalFull =
            totalMaximum > 0
            && projectedTotal >= totalMaximum;

          const roleFull =
            roleMaximum <= 0
            || Number(roleUsed[role] || 0) >= roleMaximum;

          const backup =
            totalFull || roleFull;

          let reason = '';

          if (backup) {
            reason = totalFull
              ? `Backup: supererebbe il massimo totale di ${totalMaximum} giocatori.`
              : `Backup: supererebbe il massimo ${role} di ${roleMaximum} giocatori.`;
          } else {
            projectedTotal += 1;
            r

--- MATCH 1 @ 772536 ---
 renderAuctionRolePhaseAdminPanel() {
      const phase = state.auction?.rolePhase;
      const session = auctionSession();

      if (
        !phase
        || !session
        || !auctionCallMode()
        || !auctionCanControl()
      ) {
        return '';
      }

      const controllerAction =
        phase.allReady
        && !session.current_player_id
          ? phase.hasNext
            ? `
                <button id="auction-advance-role-phase" class="auction-role-phase-action" type="button">
                  CONFERMA FASE SUCCESSIVA
                </button>
              `
            : '<span class="badge good">ULTIMA FASE COMPLETA · PUOI TERMINARE L’ASTA</span>'
          : '';

      if (!controllerAction) {
        return '';
      }

      return `
        <div class="auction-role-phase-admin-footer">
          ${controllerAction}
        </div>
      `;
    }
